title: Gatejaw Custodian
text: Gatejaw Custodian demands a formal right of passage while a hinged execution mask closes around each wrong answer. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The hearing ends when the jaw shuts.

defeatReward.text: Gatejaw Custodian is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
